question: Which deity associated with the bīja krīṃ protects the navel and middle region on the right side?
premises: The bīja krīṃ is invoked in this protective formula.
The navel and the middle region are named as the parts to be protected.
Kālikā is the deity called upon to grant protection on the right side.
inference: Kālikā, empowered by the bīja krīṃ, is petitioned to protect the navel and the middle region on the right side.
uncertainties: Whether dakṣiṇe qualifies the location of the body parts or the directional placement of Kālikā is not fully explicit.
plain_english: May Kālikā, with the bīja krīṃ, protect my navel and the middle region on the right side.
